Work in pairs. One person types (driver), the other reviews and advises (navigator). Swap roles halfway through!

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(r02pro)
library(NHANES)
library(gt)
library(DT)

# When you render, Quarto fills `params` from the YAML header. If you run the
# chunks one at a time in RStudio, this line supplies the same defaults.
if (!exists("params")) params <- list(continent = "Asia", year = 2010, sex = "female")
```

# Exercise 4: A Mini Report + AI Audit (Cycle 4)

```{r}
#| label: ex4-data
# Given: prepare one sex's adults once, with a function
prep_adults <- function(data, sex) {
  stopifnot(sex %in% c("female", "male"))
  data |>
    filter(Age >= 20, Gender == sex, !is.na(Diabetes), !is.na(BMI)) |>
    mutate(age_group = cut(Age, breaks = c(20, 35, 50, 65, Inf), right = FALSE,
                           labels = c("20-34", "35-49", "50-64", "65+")),
           obese = BMI >= 30)
}
```

```{r}

#    three AND the sex (inline R works for text too: params$sex).

```
